title: Black Sesame Salad Dressing
summary: A creamy, nutty salad dressing made with ground toasted black sesame seeds, mayonnaise, vinegar, and honey.

steps.description: Grind 2 tbsp toasted black sesame seeds in a mortar or blender until fine. A little texture is fine.
In a bowl, combine 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp vinegar, 2 tsp honey, 1 tsp soy sauce, and the ground sesame seeds. Add a pinch of salt if desired.
Whisk until evenly mixed, then add 1 tbsp water. If too thick, add up to 1 tbsp more water to reach your preferred consistency. Use the finished dressing immediately.
